items.title: Test clearer affiliate merchandising CTA on allthingsmasonic.com
items.summary: A reversible affiliate conversion experiment is warranted after current active work and measurement gates clear. Available evidence records 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for 2026-09-21; public inspection documented existing CTA hierarchy, destinations, disclosure, and accessibility evidence. This supports testing clarity, not a revenue claim.
items.requested_action: Retain as a CEO/CTO handoff only. Later prototype one existing merchandising surface with clearer product relevance, CTA copy, and disclosure placement; preserve destinations, consent, and attribution boundaries.

items.title: Prototype offline document-to-content workflow with MarkItDown
items.summary: microsoft/markitdown is a plausible fleet utility for turning source documents into Markdown drafts, structured briefs, and reusable SEO inputs. The repository signal is persistent across daily, weekly, and monthly trend windows; the CRO lab found MIT licensing, 194 files, 22 purpose-specific keyword hits, and 8 bounded checks passed. This is feasibility evidence only.
items.requested_action: Retain as a disposable, offline prototype brief. Later test on synthetic or already-authorized fixture documents only; do not connect production sources, publish generated copy, install dependencies in production, or add a runtime dependency without CTO/security review.

items.title: Prototype a reusable accessible CTA and comparison-card pattern
items.summary: shadcn-ui/ui offers customizable accessible components that could standardize CTA, disclosure, comparison-card, and navigation patterns across affiliate and editorial sites. The CRO lab found MIT licensing and passed all 3 available bounded checks; adoption remains unapproved.
items.requested_action: Retain as a CTO review brief only. Later build a standalone preview using existing fleet styling tokens and no production integration; require dependency, security, accessibility, bundle-size, and maintenance review before any adoption.
